name: NTW-20
description:
A Sudenkaap anti-materiel rifle that is used against anything from equipment to against personnel. A very heavy rifle that has the power to match with its 20x82mm ammunition.
However, you must be crouching, prone or be near a valid spot, such as a window or a ledge to rest your bipod to take aim. But this can be remedied with shorter barrels.
